# CoDUO-YAP

CoD Coop loads the independently distributed CoDUO-YAP plugin. The plugin is
not included in the MIT licensing of CoD Coop's own code.

- Upstream: <https://github.com/Clippy95/CoDUO-YAP>
- Selected release: <https://github.com/Clippy95/CoDUO-YAP/releases/tag/r169>
- Source tag: <https://github.com/Clippy95/CoDUO-YAP/tree/cfb01070cea05ab7055684fa340070731026252b>
- Source archive: <https://github.com/Clippy95/CoDUO-YAP/archive/cfb01070cea05ab7055684fa340070731026252b.tar.gz>
- Upstream license: [GNU General Public License version 3](LICENSE).

Keep this notice, the complete license and the matching source material with
any release that redistributes the plugin. The selected release DLL has
SHA-256 `9111847c9ed2f1afbdb513d22f2f87f60e23766ba48df60f813d22e1dcaaf431`.
Its own branding says r171 although its release asset is under r169; the source
tag has not been proven to reproduce the distributed binary. A release must
resolve the matching-source provenance before treating this as a distributable
complete bundle. Do not present a source URL alone as a completed source bundle.

Upstream credits include RTCW-SP/MP, ioquake3, AlphaYellow's Widescreen Fixes,
IW1x Client, ModUtils, SafetyHook, Ultimate ASI Loader, momo5502 and JBShady.
Retain the upstream project's own credits and applicable dependency notices
when packaging its binary and source. No upstream notice was removed from
the binary used for the integration tests.
